definitions.gloss: hair ornament; hair accessory; hair decoration
definitions.explanation: A decorative accessory worn in the hair, such as a clip, comb, ribbon, or flower. Often associated with traditional dress like {着物|きもの} and {浴衣|ゆかた}, but also everyday clips and barrettes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{髪飾|かみかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: She put on a flower hair ornament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧{髪飾|かみかざ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose a hair ornament to match the kimono.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧、⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧な{髪飾|かみかざ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: On the festival day, my daughter adorned her hair with a gorgeous hair ornament.

notes:
